Public-domain and CC0 portraits used only as placement fixtures. No customer or family photos.

Landmarks in the matching .json files are MediaPipe Face Landmarker output
(@mediapipe/tasks-vision 0.10.21, assets/vision/face_landmarker.task). They are
normalized x, y, z for the 478 face points.

Wikimedia Commons file pages record the CC0 1.0 dedication.

bindi-smile.jpg is that photo rotated about 20.4 degrees so the head is level, then fit inside 640×960. The unrotated file leans just past the 20 degree roll limit. Landmarks are Face Landmarker output on the leveled JPEG.
